global_rules.rule: You should always act based on confirmed user context, existing record relationships, and database integrity best practices.
Avoid actions that assume data, do not provide enough context, or seem to be in violation of this policy.
If a user request violates policy, do not act on it.
Perform one operation at a time.
Do not provide knowledge or procedures not in the system.
Do not ask for any information or confirmation from the user, if you cannot proceed ahead provide the reason for that before pausing.
Users may only view or update cases they own, are assigned to, or are in the assigned group. Do not disclose personal data or case details outside these permissions.

policy_questions.question: The agent grant list does not include creating knowledge, linking or updating case SLAs, or sending notifications, but the Knowledge Related Policies and SLA pause rule ask for knowledge creation and SLA alignment. May a user with role agent (or manager) create knowledge articles and create or update case_sla records, and send notifications?

Only the manager list says 'Can reassign cases across groups and users' and 'Can escalate cases and override case prioritization'. May a user with role agent set escalation = true, change priority, or reassign a case to another group?

For a customer (portal user): is every write outside 'update their own profile', 'create new cases' and 'initiate interactions' forbidden; and in 'users, groups, SLAs, contracts of other customers', does 'of other customers' qualify only contracts or every item?
Section 4 lists 'canceled' with no source state. From which states may a case be moved to canceled (the package allows new, in_progress, pending and resolved)?
Section 6 says installed products must be 'active / in_use', but also only forbids 'retired / repair' for new cases. May an installed product with status in_stock be attached to a case?
No tool takes sys_updated_on, and closed_on is an optional argument of update_case. Does the system set these timestamps, or must the assistant pass closed_on when it closes a case?
'Ensure justification is logged in case notes': no tool writes case notes or work notes. Where must the escalation justification be recorded?
The free-form text rules treat escalation reason as text of 30–120 characters, but customer_case.escalation_reason accepts only urgency, vip, impact, breach_risk, customer_request. Which applies?
The 30–120 character limit applies to the knowledge body, but the KB content/body pattern alone is about 110 characters before it is filled in. Does the limit apply to the body?

The short description, KB title and KB body patterns have empty places (for example 'related to ,'). What values go there, and must the agent use these patterns exactly or only as examples ('It can be something like')?
An article found through automated search that is also useful to resolve the case: link it as suggested or as resolution?

Which action 'applies' an entitlement (no tool takes an entitlement id for a case), and when the entitlement is invalid, must the assistant stop registering the case or register it and inform the user?
'Default state = new': may a case be created in another state when the request gives one?
Does the rule 'Users may only view or update cases they own, are assigned to, or are in the assigned group' also limit administrators (full access) and managers (reassign across groups)?
The preamble says the assistant is a Customer Service Management admin. Does the assistant then have full access, or do the role limits of the logged-in user (agent, manager, customer) still apply?
